A '''mission''' took place around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] when [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] went to [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] to investigate [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]]. She was subsequently captured, but was later rescued by a team of two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]
